query: WITH bounded AS ( SELECT json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS branch_id, json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS cut FROM json_each(?) ) SELECT history_entry.id, history_entry.branch_id, history_entry.position, history_entry.kind FROM history_entry JOIN bounded ON bounded.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id AND history_entry.position <= bounded.cut WHERE (history_entry.branch_id > ? OR (history_entry.branch_id = ? AND history_entry.position >= ?)) ORDER BY history_entry.branch_id, history_entry.position LIMIT ?
